definitions.full: H2606. Chananel חֲנַנְאֵל proper name, masculine ( E l; is gracious ; compare Phoenician אלחנן חננבעל, , etc.) — name of a tower at Jerusalem Jer 31:38 ; Zech 14:10 ; Neh 3:1 ; 12:39 .
